title: fix(cloud-connection,cli): install a .custom export into the target's writable pair
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg3ZC3s18ft9tCqEDmXcUmR4)_

Fixes #30106

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：一个环境导出的 `.custom` 定制包，装到另一个环境时，现在写进目标环境自己的可写配对包：先走配对包的 ensure 门，再逐项走 Studio 编辑用的保存门。不再当成代码注册。
- 为什么改：以前安装报成功，但目标环境一条覆盖都没生效，定制读数为 0，配对包还变成只读，管理员在目标环境再也改不了。修复前在 dev 上实测复现。
- 风险与回滚：只影响 id 以 `.custom` 结尾的配对包安装。某项保存被拒时，本次新建的配对包整包删掉；原有的配对包保留，答复列出写了和没写的项。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`（`installCustomizationPair` 与 `pairInstallWriteFailure`）；`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-customization-pair.ts`（哪些键算条目、写入顺序）；`packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts`（输出）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-customization-pair-install.test.ts`，预期 15 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` now installs a base's paired customization package (`BASE.custom`, what `GET /packages/BASE.custom/export` writes) as what ADR-0146 D2 / D3 say it is: an ordinary writable package whose items are stored rows.

- **The pair install** (`installCustomizationPair`, `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`). The steps run in this order, and nothing is written before the last one:
  1. The body is converted forward and walked into its items (`planCustomizationPairInstall`, new pure module `marketplace-install-local-customization-pair.ts`).
  2. The managed install's override write gate (2d) and field-patch target check (2e) run, with the same answers as before.
  3. The pair manifest must declare what the ensure door writes (`customizationPairManifestRefusal`). A pair already read-only here is refused 409 before the ensure door is asked.
  4. The ensure door answers the writable pair, and creates it when absent.
  5. Each item is written through `saveMetaItem`, in registry load order, with `mode: 'publish'`, the pair as its package, and the installer as actor.
  Nothing is registered as code, schema-synced, or written to the cached-manifest directory. The answer carries `customizationPair` (`basePackageId`, `packageId`, `created`, `writable`), `writtenCount` and `written`.
- **What the body may carry.** It may carry the collections (`PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR`), `viewItems` and `objectExtensions` (as `object_extension` items named by their target), plus the package's own keys. A key with no item form is refused 422 and every problem is listed. That covers code, a `translations` bundle, an envelope, and a key the install-key table does not classify. A nameless item, and two items with one identity, are refused the same way. An `email_template` is keyed by `(name, locale)`, as the save door keys its row. Seed `data` is reported as not loaded.
- **A save refused part-way** answers failure with the save's own code and status, naming the item and its path. The refusal is logged at `error` with the save's own words. A pair this install created is deleted again; if that deletion does not finish, the plugin logs at `error`. A pair that existed before is kept, and the answer lists what was and was not written.
- **A pair read-only on the target** is refused 409 with a remedy that depends on why it is read-only:
  - ledgered as code by an earlier install: uninstall, restart, install again;
  - uninstalled but still registered until a restart: restart;
  - provided by code or an installed app: remove it first.
- **A pair inside a multi-package artifact** is refused 422 (`details.pairs`): a pair is installed on its own, after its base.
- **The CLI** (`os package install`) prints the pair it wrote into and the item count. A runtime that predates this answers a pair as a managed install. The CLI now prints that answer as an error with the way back and exits 1, instead of printing success.

## Tests

- New: `marketplace-install-local-customization-pair.test.ts`, the planner (7 cases).
- New: `marketplace-install-local-customization-pair-install.test.ts`, the door at its route (15 cases):
  - writes through the save door, with no register, sync or ledger;
  - an existing pair answers `created: false`;
  - seed data is reported as not loaded;
  - rollback of a pair the install created; a pre-existing pair is kept; a failed rollback is logged;
  - the three read-only refusals are asked before the ensure door;
  - the ensure door's refusal is relayed;
  - body problems, a manifest the ensure door would not write, a pair inside a bundle, and a missing door (503) are all refused before any write.
- New: `packages/cli/test/package-install-customization-pair.test.ts` (2 cases):
  - the pair success output;
  - an older runtime's as-code answer prints an error and exits 1.
- Updated: `marketplace-install-local-override-gate.test.ts` (3 cases) and `marketplace-install-local-extension-field-suffix.test.ts` (1 case) pinned a pair registered as code (`registered === [PAIR]`). They now pin it written into its pair (`registered === []`, saves named). Their harness gains the pair's doors, and the base declares the namespace its pair's is derived from.
- Updated: `packages/cli/test/package-export.test.ts` (1 case). Its round-trip stub now answers the pair entry in the pair shape.
- `@objectstack/cloud-connection` full suite at `6be0aea6a`: Test Files 70 passed (70), Tests 846 passed (846).
- `@objectstack/cli` unit project (`vitest run --project unit`): 382 of 383 files passed, and 5381 of 5382 tests. The one failure was `test/package-export.test.ts`, whose round-trip stub answered the exported pair as code. It now answers the pair shape, and the file passes 6/6. The `integration` tier is left to CI.
- Dogfood, unchanged files: `package-export-reinstall-custom-pair` and `package-export-bundle-round-trip` (2 files, 16 tests) pass at `6be0aea6a`. The second installs a pair entry on a fresh target and re-exports it.

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-② re-check, measured.** This PR copies the claim's `Clause-②: no`. On measurement, two facts may read as an arm, and they are left to the seat:
  - (narrowing) a pair-id body carrying a key with no item form, or a pair inside a multi-package artifact, is now refused, where before it was registered as code;
  - (widening) a pair install's answer gains `customizationPair`, `writtenCount` and `written`, and drops `hotLoaded` and `storageDir`.
- **Cached-manifest location.** A managed install's cache is `LocalManifestSource`'s default, `CWD/.objectstack/installed-packages`, and is not keyed by `OS_HOME`. That breaks `os dev --fresh` isolation: a ledgered entry rehydrates under a new `OS_HOME`. A pair no longer writes one at all. Moving the directory for other packages needs a read-old-location fallback, so this PR leaves it. Measured: the pre-fix install wrote `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/com.example.showcase.custom.json` under a fresh `OS_HOME`, and a fresh boot rehydrated an entry placed there.
- **After `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/ID`, the package still reads read-only until a restart.** The engine's manifest map keeps the id. `POST /packages/BASE/ensure-customization` then answered `201 created: true, writable: false`. Measured on the pre-fix and fixed builds. The 409 above names the restart for this reason.
- Read from code, not measured:
  - the pair export omits `emailTemplates` and translation items, so those overrides do not round-trip;
  - `--install-mode unmanaged` on a pair still takes the unmanaged copy path;
  - the install-time override gate's `overrideWriteItemsOf` does not read `viewItems` (for a pair the save door judges each item).
- No `packages/spec` edit. The file surface is the claim's: `packages/cli/src/commands/package/**`, plus the install door that `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` hands install-local to (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-*.ts`).

## Verification

Dev measurement, two `os dev` showcase runtimes. Source: customize a view and a dashboard into the pair, publish, `os package export`. Target: `os package install` the pair's `objectstack.json`.

<details><summary>Before the fix (main 07595c07)</summary>

```text
install exit 0  ✓ Package installed into the running kernel
target read view showcase_task.in_progress {"label":"In Progress"}            (base label)
target customizations 200 {"overrides":0,...}
target ensure {"created":false,"writable":false}
target save into pair 422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED
ledger: examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/com.example.showcase.custom.json (fresh OS_HOME)
```
</details>

<details><summary>After the fix: fresh target</summary>

```text
install exit 0  ✓ Customization package installed into the writable pair of 'com.example.showcase'
                  Pair: com.example.showcase.custom (created by this install) · Items written: 2
target read view showcase_task.in_progress {"label":"OV-30106 label view","overrides":{"package":"com.example.showcase","basedOn":"0.1.0"}}
target read dashboard showcase_chart_gallery {"label":"OV-30106 label dashboard","overrides":{...}}
target customizations 200 {"overrides":2,...}
target ensure 200 {"created":false,"writable":true}
target save into pair 200 · read after save {"label":"OV-30106 label edited on target"}
install again: exit 0 · Pair: com.example.showcase.custom · Items written: 2
ledger files in cwd: []   (every step)
```
</details>

<details><summary>After the fix: a target holding the pair as code from an earlier install</summary>

```text
boot with the pair ledgered → install exit 1
  409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT: ... installed here as code, by an earlier install ... Uninstall it (DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/com.example.showcase.custom), restart this runtime ..., and install it again ...
DELETE install-local 200
install exit 1
  409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT: ... has been uninstalled, but its code registration stays in this runtime until it restarts ... Restart this runtime and install it again ...
restart → install exit 0 · Items written: 2 · customizations {"overrides":2}
restart again → customizations {"overrides":2}, both override labels served
```
</details>

<details><summary>Gates at 6be0aea6a</summary>

```text
node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack  → 64 commands, each run, exit codes recorded before any pipe
non-zero on the first pass (at c039b0ed):
  pnpm check:durability-log-level :: exit 1
    (the save loop's catch had no log; it now logs at error with the save's own words)
  node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test :: exit 3
    (shallow clone; its pinned fixture commit fetched)
final pass at 6be0aea6a: 64 :: exit 0
dispatch-gates --ran: 64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED
pnpm lint :: exit 0
```
</details>
